title: BashFile
tagline: BashFile allows users to store their files on the decentralized network for lifetime at a fixed price.
description:
Build BashFile Dapp using Lighthouse SDK which runs a storage endowment pool whose job is to pay for the user files till perpetuity. This is of utmost priority for many applications, for example, NFT where many users are unaware that somebody has to pay for their NFTs over time which is generally a centralized mechanism and otherwise might lead to a broken NFT.
The project BashFile deployed in spheron network, the Decentralized cloud host.
how_its_made:
following the Lighthouse SDK Docs ( https://docs.lighthouse.storage )
Host the Dapp in Spheron network, the Decentralized cloud:
 - Infinite storage and bandwidth.
 - 5x Cheaper than centralized providers.
 - 100% Censorship, Hacking, Outage, Track Proof.
 - Transparent, Immutable and Cryptographic ally Verifiable.
